subsection.name: What
subsection.p: TomcatCon London is the place for all users of Tomcat to expand their Tomcat knowledge in areas such as networking, security, performance and deployment. It also offers an opportunity to discuss the current Tomcat roadmap and help inform future development.
Registration for TomcatCon London is now open.

09.20 State of the Cat
A review of the past year or so for Apache Tomcat and a look forward to what is expected in the coming 12 months. In particular, this will include the progress of Tomcat 9 towards its first stable release.
